jobs.d1_clock: tall vertical picture: a plain hallway by the front door in the morning. In the upper half hangs one very big round wall clock with a plain blank white face, no numbers and no marks on it, only two big thick black hands from the centre: one long, one short. The main character stands below it in the lower half, dressed in a hurry: one plain grey scarf thrown around its neck, one plain shoe on one hind paw, holding the other plain shoe in one front paw; it stares up at the clock with huge horrified eyes, mouth wide open in shock, fur bristled; three small sweat drops fly off its head. The flame on the tip of its tail flares big. LAYOUT: the clock and the character are both big and whole, the clock in the upper part, the character from the floor up to the middle, a small clear gap between the clock and the character's head; a plain closed door at one side; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.d2_sock: tall vertical picture: a plain bedroom in bright late-morning daylight. The main character kneels on the floor in front of one open plain chest of drawers and digs in the bottom drawer, throwing clothes over its shoulder; three pieces of clothing fly through the air behind it, apart from each other; it wears one plain sock on one hind paw, the other hind paw is bare; an annoyed, flustered face, ears back. On a small bedside table one round alarm clock with a plain blank face lies tipped over on its side. The flame on its tail is small and nervous. LAYOUT: the character and the drawer are big and whole in the lower half; the flying clothes in clear space above; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.d3_door: tall vertical picture: a calm plain hallway at the front door in the morning. The main character stands by the closed front door and calmly hangs one round alarm clock with a plain blank face on a small hook on the wall right next to the door, at the height of its head, a calm focused face with a small confident smile; a plain bag hangs on another hook, a pair of plain shoes stands neatly by the door. The flame on its tail burns even and bright. LAYOUT: the character is big and whole in the lower middle, the alarm clock clearly visible beside the door near its raised paw; plain wall; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.d4_first: tall vertical picture: a bright plain meeting room in the morning. The main character sits alone at one end of a long plain table with several empty chairs, upright, chin up, eyes half closed with a proud happy smile, both front paws resting on the table; a plain coat hangs neatly on the back of its chair; the room is empty except for it. The flame on its tail burns big, golden and bright with a few tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the character is big and whole in the lower middle, the long table and empty chairs lead toward it; plain wall; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.d5_timer: tall vertical picture: a plain cosy living room. The main character sits on a sofa holding one tiny round kitchen timer in both front paws close to its chest with a calm, naive little smile; above its head floats one small thought cloud with one tiny plain timer inside; right behind the sofa on the wall hangs one very big round wall clock with a plain blank face and two hands, much bigger than the character's head. The flame on its tail is small and calm. LAYOUT: the character on the sofa is big and whole in the lower half; the thought cloud above its head; the big wall clock in the upper part, clearly separate; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.d6_out: tall vertical picture: a sunny street right outside a front door in the morning. The main character walks out of an open front door calmly and lightly, fully dressed, one plain bag over its shoulder, both shoes on, a relaxed happy face with half-closed eyes, mid-step; a small green bush by the door, a light sky. The flame on its tail burns bright and even. LAYOUT: the character is big and whole in the lower middle, the open door behind it on one side; plain sky; no letters or numbers anywhere.
